# Modelbuch pattern pages (Quentel 1544, Sibmacher 1597)

Knotted ribbons, figure-eight loops, floral diamonds and the repeating bands and corners of embroidery pattern pages from Peter Quentel's "Ein new kunstlich Modelbuch" (1544) and Johann Sibmacher's "Schön Neues Modelbuch" (1597) in the Metropolitan Museum of Art, grouped by page.

Part of [Ducktape Assets](https://github.com/adrian729/ducktape-assets). Set id `met-schoen-modelbuch`, historical, 21 assets, version 1.0.0.
